summary: SiteDocument represents a document associated with a site in the HSPnet system, tracking its SiteID and ID. It is a simple entity primarily used for linking documents to sites.
purpose: To model and store references to documents associated with a site within the HSPnet system.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a page for staff administrators in HSPnet that provides last login details, handles employment applications display, manages warning/error messages, and allows filtered searches by site, discipline, and date range.
purpose: To let staff admins view and filter submitted student employment applications, see last login info, and manage error/warning displays.

workflows.name: View Filtered Employment Applications
steps: Select site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn filter.
Refresh data via dropdown change or refresh button.
View applications with status, email links, and program info.

business_rules: Withdrawn applications shown if checkbox checked.
validations: CustomValidator to check StartDate precedes EndDate.
conditions: Show withdrawn applications based on checkbox.
Show error/warning panels if messages exist.
system_behavior: Auto-populate dropdowns and fields based on session/user.
DefaultButton for form set to refresh action.
exceptions: Error and warning panels shown if messages generated during workflow.
content_gaps: No details about how errors/warnings are generated.

summary: ServiceCode defines service codes for HSPnet, including ID, code category, short name, description, sorting order, and language-specific alternate fields. ServiceCodes provides workflow for retrieving lists and localized results.
purpose: To represent codified services used in scheduling, reporting, and classification; support alternate languages and related workflows.

workflows.name: Fetch Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to get all codes.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID for course/timetable-specific codes.
Localize results if alternate language is selected.

business_rules: If alternate language is active, Name uses NameAlt.
conditions: Language mode affects result field values.
system_behavior: Returns lists of ServiceCode objects from stored procedures.
content_gaps: No information about how codes are used outside collection workflows.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes to site profiles, recording user actions, date, fields changed, agency, and user details. Used to show history of changes for audit and support purposes.
purpose: To log and display the history of user actions and edits on site profiles for auditing, support, and user awareness.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, and session object.
Fill SiteProfileHistory list from database reader with localized fields if needed.
Display history in grid view on UI.
Show user details with formatted tooltips and agency info.

business_rules: If alternate language mode is active, use alternate fields for ScreenSection, UserAction, Fields.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted and AgencyUserDetailsFormatted depend on user and agency info.
conditions: Show support team label if sysadmin and original user differ.
content_gaps: No details about UI presentation beyond grid view.

summary: EmailPopupDocument models an email-related document for popup display, tracking filename, file path, and selection state. The workflow supports searching for available documents and deleting them, with underlying file system operations.
purpose: To handle email-related document selection, display, and deletion in the HSPnet UI for email popup scenarios.

workflows.name: Search Email Popup Documents
steps: Parse DataInfo string to extract document info.

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Delete file and containing folder from file system.
Return updated DataInfo string without deleted entry.

conditions: Delete only if entry has valid file path.
system_behavior: Deletes files and folders from disk using .NET IO.
Builds EmailPopupDocument list for UI based on delimited input string.
exceptions: File or directory deletion errors are silently caught.
content_gaps: No security rules for file deletion explained.
No details about UI use beyond basic search/delete.
